decision.reason: The cited item [ev-ea9f9415727f] is only a table-of-contents link. The section context [ev-de978b4c1ed8] just says to "review your cluster for removed features and address any that you're using". It points to removed-feature sections that are not shown, and it bundles several removals without naming any subject, before/after state or consequence. The linked PR #1 [ev-e41730af1b3a][ev-3d64f9107772] is an unrelated 2018 scaffolding PR that adds database controllers, so it adds nothing. To write the assertion we need the individual removed-feature sections of the v2 upgrade guide, each stating which feature was removed and what breaks if it is still in use.
